References have been received in this Ministry from various Ministries / Departments / Procuring entities, wherein clarifications / exemptions have been sought for the procurem€nt of electronic and IT products. 3. As per the clause-I4 of the Public Procurement (Preference to Make in India) Order 2017, exemption or reduction in minimum local content of products may be provided by Minister-in- charge ofthe Department / Ministry concerned. 4. ln this regard, following has been clarified: 4.1 In furtherance of the Public Procurement (Preference to Make in India) Order 2017, the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) has notified mechanism for calculating local content for l3 Electronic Products viz., (i) Desktop PCs, (ii) Thin Clients, (iiD Computer Monitors, (iv) Laptop PCs, (v) Tablet PCs, (vi) Dot Matrix Printers, (vii) Contact and Contactless Smart Cards, (viii) LED Products, (ix) Biometric Access Control / Authentication Devices, (x) Biometric Finger Print Sensors, (xi) Biometric Iris Sensors, (xii) Servers, and (xiii) Cellular Mobile Phones. MeitY has not notified mechanism for calculating local content for otler electronic products where the local content will continue to be govemed by the PPP-MII Ord,er L/ 2017 dated 16.09.2020 issued by DPIIT. 4.2 Moreover, Meit* in consultation with the Industry has framed Model Technical Specifications of Desktop PCs, Laptop PCs and Tablet PCs for procurement to be made by Ministries / Departments and their agencies / PSUs.
